text:
alex: Quick heads-up — found an indirect config chain that can cascade across operators. Thinking we need an operator dependency graph + a quarantine playbook to prevent downstream surprise rollouts. :warning:

sam: Can you paste the chain or where you saw it?

alex: Saw it in prod logs for customer-42. Simplified flow below:

```yaml
operator_a:
  sets: feature_x: true
operator_b:
  if feature_x: set_quota: low
operator_c:
  if quota == low: switch_model: 'small'
```

We currently have zero visibility in the console that these three are linked — so a feature flip in A can silently change model in C.

nina: Oof. That's the kind of hidden coupling that can make a canary look fine then cause a degraded P0 later.

chris: Agree. Proposal (prio order):
1) console: visualize dependency graph (nodes + outgoing edges)
2) quarantine tagging: ability to mark a config/operator as quarantined which auto-pauses downstream rollouts
3) telemetry: alert when downstream resource changes (model/quota) exceed threshold within short window.

priya: For the quarantine playbook I'm thinking steps: mark node 'quarantined' + reason, freeze downstream rollouts, route traffic to last-known-good override, open incident ticket with prefilled context, run snapshot diffs for recent evals. :lock:

alex: API surface we need: GET /configs/:id/dependencies -> list of edges; POST /configs/:id/quarantine {reason, expires_at?} -> sets quarantine_state. Must always write audit entry.

sam: DB concern: store dependencies as edge table (from_id, to_id) with weak refs. quarantine_state enum + updated_by + updated_at. Keep reads fast; we can denormalize some graph metadata into a small cache.

jordan: Prefer side-table + eventual consistency. Avoid putting graph traversal in critical path of config fetch. Console can show 'graph may be stale' badge when cache lag > 2m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started background job config-dep-scan for customer-42 (job_id: jd-2026-03-21-42)

nina: Telemetry idea: metric config.dependent_changes.rate and an alert if downstream model switches > 5% of requests in 10m window. Also add a sampled event (include request id, config stack) to help root-cause. :eyes:

chris: UX notes: hover a node to show 'blame' table (origin config id, last change, last deploy user). Quarantine CTA should show exact consequences: "will pause X downstream rollouts for Y minutes" and require a short justification.

priya: Cycles: we must detect cycles at commit time and surface lint errors (and in the console graph). Also define a safe default for cycles: break on the oldest operator by created_at unless manually overridden.

alex: I'll draft a short RFC (API + DB sketch + console mock) later today. Who can own console visual + wiring?

sam: I can own console visuals + frontend endpoint wiring.

jordan: I'll prototype the dep-scan job and add the sampled telemetry events.

alex: Great. After RFC we should add the quarantine checklist to oncall runbooks and the deploy pipeline preflight checks.

chris: One more: add a dry-run mode for POST /configs/:id/quarantine that simulates downstream impact and returns a list of downstream rollouts that would be paused. Very helpful for runbooks.

priya: +1 to dry-run. Also include estimated traffic % impacted in the dry-run output.

sam: timeline: frontend spike next week, API + side-table in two weeks, dep-scan prototype this sprint. Sound ok?

alex: Sounds good. I'll tag infra for capacity if dep-scan needs an offline job. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
